home.metaTitle: Flami — your menu online, orders in WhatsApp and Telegram
home.metaDescription: Put your menu online in minutes. Customers order from your link and the full order arrives in your WhatsApp or Telegram. Free, no commission.

hero.title: Your menu on one link. Orders straight to your chat.
hero.lead: Customers open your menu, pick their food and check out. The full order lands in your WhatsApp or Telegram — items, total, address and all.
hero.note: No app for your customers. No commission on your sales.

demo.label: Animated demo: a customer adds a doner, fries and ayran, then sends the order to the shop on WhatsApp.

steps.title: From menu to first order in three steps

s1.title: Add your menu
s1.body: Upload photos, set prices and add options like size or extra sauce. Change anything later in seconds.

s2.title: Share your link
s2.body: Put flami.org/your-store in your Instagram bio, print the QR code for tables, or send it to regulars.

s3.title: Get orders in chat
s3.body: Each order arrives in WhatsApp or Telegram, ready to cook — with a map pin for deliveries.

features.title: Built for the way you already sell
features.lead: Your customers already message you to order. Flami turns that into a proper menu and a tidy order, without changing where you talk to them.
features.chatTitle: Orders you can read at a glance
features.chatBody: No more back-and-forth to work out what someone wants. Every order comes in the same clear format.

menu.title: A menu that sells
menu.body: Photos, categories, options and a sold-out switch. Search and quick add on any phone.

track.title: Customers track their order
track.body: Each order gets its own page that updates as you accept, cook and send it out.

board.title: One board for every order
board.body: Accept, mark ready, mark paid. See what is waiting and what is done.

delivery.title: Delivery and pickup
delivery.body: Flat delivery fee, minimum order, and the customer’s location on a map.

payment.title: Get paid your way
payment.body: Cash, card on delivery or bank transfer. Customers pay you directly.

hours.title: Opening hours that just work
hours.body: Set your hours and time zone. When you are closed, customers see when you open next.

qr.title: A QR code for your tables
qr.body: Download it once and put it on tables, flyers and takeaway bags.

currency.title: Any currency
currency.body: Dollars, euros, won, lira — pick yours when you create the store.

audience.text: Made for kebab shops, bakeries, cafés, dessert shops, coffee carts, food trucks and home cooks who take orders by message.

pricing.title: Free while we are in early access
pricing.lead: Every feature, unlimited orders, no card needed. If a paid plan ever comes, you will hear about it well in advance.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Do my customers need to install an app?
faq.a1: No. Your store is a web page that opens in any phone browser. The order is sent through the WhatsApp or Telegram app they already have.
faq.a2: When a customer checks out, the order is saved and opens as a ready-made message to your WhatsApp number or Telegram account. Every order also appears on your order board.
faq.q3: Do you take a cut of my sales?
faq.a3: No. Customers pay you directly — cash, card on delivery or bank transfer. Flami never handles the money.
faq.q4: Can I use my own currency and time zone?
faq.a4: Yes. Choose them when you create your store, and change them later in settings.
faq.q5: Can I change my menu later?
faq.a5: Anytime. Edits show on your store right away, including marking a dish as sold out for the day.
faq.q6: What happens when I am closed?
faq.a6: Customers can still browse your menu and see when you open next, but they cannot place an order.

final.title: Your first online order could arrive tonight
final.body: Setting up takes about five minutes.

push.installTitle: Add Flami to your home screen
push.installSteps:
On iPhone, notifications only work from the home-screen app:
1. Tap the Share button in Safari
2. Choose “Add to Home Screen”
3. Open Flami from the home screen and tap “Notify me”
push.deniedSteps: Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings (the lock icon next to the address), then reload the page.
